content: Substack publication RSS (<pub>.substack.com/feed or custom domain /feed) returns the ~20 most recent posts (verified live: newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/feed = 20 items). No stats in feed. Full archive is reachable only via the UNOFFICIAL undocumented JSON endpoint /api/v1/posts?limit&offset (title, subtitle, slug, post_date, canonical_url, word_count) or /api/v1/archive — unofficial, rate-limited, may break. Paid-post bodies are truncated.
